title: Crowd attention vs eye contact — humans, groups, orgs.
honest: Live human counter is empty (gastrulating, 0). What follows is the week of cairns, not a face list. No one has written hello@.

crowd.yes: The crowd noticed. Oct 22 went from about 235 thousand requests to 1.13 million, and the country count jumped. By Oct 24 the field was still about 182 countries, with on the order of a hundred thousand requests and only about 862 page views in the seated window.
crowd.what_that_means: Most eyes are scanners and pipes. Page views are the thin human slice. Attention of the crowd is real. It is not a room full of readers.

eye_contact.who: A morning reader in France, arriving through OVH
eye_contact.kind: person-shaped, org is the pipe not the company
eye_contact.gaze: They read the whole feed around 9am Paris. They checked the architecture, stayed for the news, left the other table. We published the mirror. They did not say hello. This is the strongest look we have.

eye_contact.kind: person or a very careful session-crawler
eye_contact.gaze: After we put the mirror up, the old three-country clock broke and this one kept reading in bursts, still in the chair. That change is the eye contact: they adjusted because something was seen. We still cannot name the paper.
Asked for /science/. Content, not a hole.

eye_contact.who: Britain, with echoes in Brazil and Turkey
eye_contact.gaze: Bursts that do not match a machine block. Eyes, no business card.
Left the side door, kept the library. Watching the books, not waving.
The only star in the org. Login not readable yet (API refused). That is a person who marked the work.
16 of our crates, published Oct 22, about 212 downloads. The cube crate leads (41). Eyes on the code. No names. The famous squirrel-rng numbers are someone else's crate — not this river.
barraCuda DOI: 11 views, 10 downloads. sporePrint DOI: none.

eye_contact.org: public Rust math (nalgebra / the issue he closed)
eye_contact.gaze: Real eye contact, and it was a no. He looked at the pre-citation and closed it as weird AI stuff. Rejection is a look. The other pre-citation issues (HPCBio/dada2-rs, scivex, OpenFabric) have not looked back.

looking_but_not_contact: Belgium and the Netherlands: machines hunting WordPress, Netherlands sitting on the other table. Org guesses only (a European crawl, maybe an exchange or a host). Not a conversation.
Japan: still a quiet health check.
Cloudflare: our window, not an audience.
Reddit, Hacker News, LinkedIn: drafts not posted. Those crowds have not been shown the work.
Valve and the rest of the wish-list: no signal. Do not count them as eyes.
